quiz.title: Grammaire de base : articles, prépositions, pronoms personnels
quiz.subject: Anglais

questions.question: Which of the following is a definite article in English?
'The indefinite articles in English are 'a' and 'an'' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English preposition?
'The preposition 'in' is used to indicate location inside something' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English personal pronoun?
'The personal pronoun 'she' is used to refer to a female person' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English possessive pronoun?
'The possessive pronoun 'our' is used to refer to something that belongs to us' is a true statement.
